title: AS2 gotoAndPlay/gotoAndStop as method calls on non-root timelines
description: gotoAndPlay and gotoAndStop are hardcoded as free-function builtins emitting ActionGotoFrame2. When called as methods (myClip.gotoAndPlay(2) or _root.gotoAndPlay(2)), the builtin fast-path is bypassed and the generic CallMethod path runs instead. Verify _root.gotoAndPlay() resolves correctly via GetVariable('_root') + CallMethod in Ruffle, and fix any case where it produces wrong AVM1 output.
